title: Older Blocks
description: Mix and match modern vanilla with classic pre-1.13.2 textures! Adds nostalgic art style blocks as separate variants for your builds.
body:
Instead of using a resource pack to bring back Minecraft's old art style for your builds, I have decided it would be better to mix and match the textures to your liking by adding separate "Older" blocks to make your builds look the way you want them to. This mod adds the classic pre-1.13.2 textures as brand-new older block variants. This gives you access to a nostalgic palette, allowing for diverse creativity using more than what is just given to you in modern vanilla!

### Planned Features:
* Cobblestone and different shapes
* 3 Stones (Andesite, Granite, Diorite)
* End Stone and Purpur blocks from the End
* Fences, walls, trapdoors, and doors
* More mineral and gem blocks (like the classic Gold Block)
* Ports for Fabric and NeoForge mod loaders
* Support for newer and older Minecraft versions
